models.fellowshipPresence: Live participation context shown at the top of the Fellowship hub.
models.testimony: A public story of God's work shared by a believer, with optional media and reactions.
models.prayerPoint: A prayer request users can commit to pray for, optionally restricted to ministry intercessors.
models.counselingRequest: A private support request submitted to the counseling team with triage details.

relationships: A testimony belongs to one user identity (named or anonymous) and can include zero or one media attachment.
A prayer point can receive many prayer commitments from users, represented by prayedCount.
A counseling request belongs to one user and progresses through statuses: Received, In Review, Scheduled.
Fellowship presence is shared context for all three cards in the hub.

testimonies.content: After weeks of fear, the Lord gave me peace during morning prayer. I slept well for the first time in months.
I prayed for reconciliation with my brother, and yesterday we spoke after three years of silence. Imana is faithful.
I was looking for work for five months. The church prayed with me, and this week I started a new job. I am grateful for every prayer.

I had hidden anxiety for a long time and smiled in public while feeling empty inside. Over the past month, through daily verses, short exhortations, and consistent prayer from believers here, I started rebuilding daily routines, sleeping better, and talking honestly with my family. I am still in process, but I can now say with confidence that God met me in this dark season and gave me hope again.
My son passed his exams after we prayed together every evening. Murakoze Yesu.
Thank you for praying for my mother. Her recovery is improving week by week.
